message_text: I've been trying to reach the registrar's office for 3 days. Nobody answers the phone.
I'm sorry about that. The Registrar's office is experiencing high call volumes. You can submit a request through the online ticketing system at registrar.university.edu/help.
I need my enrollment verification letter for my employer ASAP. I can't wait for a ticket.
Enrollment verification letters can actually be requested instantly through the National Student Clearinghouse at studentclearinghouse.org. It's the fastest option.
Oh I didn't know that. Why doesn't the website mention this?
That's a great point. I'll suggest adding this information to our Registrar FAQ page. Thank you for the feedback.
